name: SIM Debate Pairs
description: Test fixture for the pairs brick: partners dealt opposite sides, an opening, a rebuttal with the partner piece in view, a switch, then a pair-private reveal. Underscore-prefixed so it never appears in game lists. Compiled by the brick itself; driven by scripts/simulate-debate-pairs.js.

pair-write.prompt: Should homework be banned? You are arguing {{pair-write.side}}. Write your opening argument.

pair-round.prompt:
Read your partner opening below. Write a rebuttal, still arguing {{pair-write.side}}.

{{pair-write.partner}}
